title: Sneakers
subtitle: 3D modeling of a cyberpunk shoe
description:
This project is based on the 3D modeling of a cyberpunk style shoe, combining neon light effects, stylized metals and an urban aesthetic.

Its development came out of pure passion and curiosity, with the aim of learning and exploring the design of original fashion pieces.

The personal goal of the project was to learn how to model and texture with a high level of detail, using ZBrush, 3ds Max and Substance Painter. I took care of every little element of the shoe to achieve a realistic and faithful result to the cyberpunk style.
